settings.nav: Show "Who Said It?" in the forum's sidebar
settings.timezone: Quiz day starts at midnight in
settings.timezone_help: A new quiz starts at midnight in this time zone, and members who asked are reminded then.
settings.min_age: Quotes must be at least this many days old
settings.min_age_help: Older posts make better guessing, and nobody gets quoted on something they wrote this morning.
settings.min_length_help: Measured after quotes of other posts, links, code and spoilers are taken out.
settings.repeat: Don't use the same quote again for this many days
settings.repeat_help: 0 means a quote can come back any time.
settings.active: Members seen in the last this many days count as active
settings.active_help: The three other faces look like the author, so they don't give the answer away. They had joined by the time the post was written, have a similar number of posts, and are as active as the author is (seen within this many days, or not).
settings.tags: Only quote posts in these tags
settings.groups: Never quote members of these groups
settings.groups_help: For bots, feed importers or anyone else who shouldn't be in the game. Members of these groups are never quoted and never shown as a choice. Members can also opt themselves out in their settings.
settings.tags_help: Leave all unticked to use every tag. Only posts that guests can read are ever quoted, so private discussions and restricted tags are never used.

status.title: Today

status.not_made: Today's quiz ({date}) hasn't been made yet.
status.eligible: {count, plural, one {# post qualifies} other {# posts qualify}} under the settings below.
status.eligible_many: More than 1,000 posts qualify under the settings below.
status.members_only: Only posts that guests can read are ever quoted. On a forum that guests can't read (members only), no posts qualify, so no quiz is made.
status.scheduler: Quizzes are made by Flarum's scheduler, or by the first visit to the quiz page each day. The quotes are never shown here, so admins can play too.
